ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alphageo (India) Limited reported a strong financial turnaround in Q1 2026, achieving a substantial profit of INR 1273.67 lakhs on significant revenue growth, reversing a loss from the previous quarter and demonstrating marked year-over-year improvement. This positive performance is overshadowed by material contingent liabilities exceeding INR 3,800 lakhs, primarily stemming from INR 1,601.08 lakhs in fixed deposits seized due to alleged FEMA violations and an INR 2,246.31 lakhs income tax demand (partially on the Managing Director and indemnified by the company), highlighting significant legal risks and corporate governance concerns despite an unmodified audit opinion.
